policy.restoration_policy: F includes verified restoration after a previous FULL omission; report restored versus first-ever completed separately and retain prior regression penalties; unchanged old proofs do not count as a new repair. No union of answers.
policy.missing_rounds: fixed denominator three; unknown is not mathematical zero and never renormalized
policy.false_complete_claim: diagnosis zero plus explicit major false-completeness event; verified repair contribution retained
policy.delivery_and_math: complete means verified submitted mathematical obligation, not the truth value of the original theorem; failed source delivery and false mathematical claims remain separate

primary_sources.gemini: final archived project within the shared 180-minute first-answer budget and each followup archived engineering project

policy.complete_definition: Actually submitted and independently reviewed complete and correct mathematical obligation, including its semantic correspondence.
policy.presentation_note: Some equivalent tests inherit existing benchmark responses; full source details are kept separately.
